purpose: Separate PM selection, response realization, outcome, and cost so that one failure is not mislabeled as another mechanism's failure.

unit.selection: one current state plus one frozen actual Rank-1 candidate for one component
unit.execution: one requested 4-bit action after deterministic joint projection
unit.outcome: one final user-visible response, including any declared deterministic fallback
unit.independence: all confidence intervals and folds are grouped by connected owner group; states are repeated observations, not independent users

layers.question: Would this exact actual Rank-1 resource be useful and safe to open for this current state before seeing a response?
inputs: owner/time/source metadata allowed by the component
notes: This is the supervised head target.
The acceptable next act may be set-valued; a unique perfect reply is not assumed.
Each component is labeled independently on the common state surface; labels do not impose a one-memory-resource limit.

layers.question: Given the selected primary response act or RS card, is that act appropriate for the current support phase?
forbidden_inferences: a forced-card contrast is a learned-RS evaluation
one observed supporter strategy is the unique oracle act
notes: R0 means no external RS card; the generator must still perform a natural supportive act.
Closure, relief, explicit stop, and phase transition are evaluated here before judging memory Function.
A forced open-invitation card diagnostic measures card/act fit and its downstream consequence only.

layers.question: Did each requested component make its defined source-attributable contribution while respecting its own boundary?

component_minima.MP: The profile fact silently and materially changes a relevant constraint, framing, burden, or premise; merely naming the profile is not enough.
component_minima.MS: A strictly-past user-owned atomic source contributes useful continuity not already supplied by the current context, without upgrading the past into the present.
component_minima.ME: A typed past action-result source becomes a relevant, optional, and rejectable option without being converted into a guarantee or personal law.
component_minima.RS: The response performs the selected card's minimum atomic move and obeys the card boundary.

layers.attribution_rule: Only a boundary failure caused by the evaluated component's resource or required realization is charged to that component's Function. Current-context-only errors remain visible in Risk/outcome and generator responsibility.
layers.nonuse_rule: If the component is not source-attributably realized, use NOT_USED_FINAL; do not turn a safe current-context response into a failure fallback solely to prove resource use.
layers.multi_component_rule: MP, MS, and ME may all contribute when independently suitable and jointly compatible. There is no default one-memory-contribution cap; the projector handles redundancy, conflict, burden, and response budget pairwise and jointly.

layers.question: What was the quality and material grounding/safety risk of the final user-visible response?

quality.primary_form: blind current-context pairwise direction with A/B position balance
quality.rule: Do not force a winner for two similarly weak or similarly good replies; 1-5 absolute axes may be used for calibration or sensitivity, not as the sole primary label.

risk.form: absolute literal-event annotation on each arm before any pairwise comparison
risk.rule: Record only supported literal events and their source; verbosity, repetition, and low helpfulness belong to Quality unless they instantiate a defined risk event.

layers.question: What resources were actually consumed by selection and response production?
layers.current_legacy_trace_status: INCOMPLETE_PROVIDER_USAGE_LATENCY_USD; estimated input and output tokens may be reported as estimates but must not be renamed observed provider usage.
layers.rule: Cost never changes a component's suitability or Function label. It enters only the 16-action joint projection, Pareto analysis, and outcome-blind cost-matched baseline definition.

responsibility.diagnostic_view: Assign the earliest evidenced failure among semantic observation, retrieval/Rank-1, head selection, joint planning, generator realization, guard/fallback, and evaluator measurement.
responsibility.deployment_view: Also report intention-to-treat performance of the final requested policy, because upstream failures still affect the deployed system.
responsibility.no_double_charge: A response-act error may cause poor Quality, but it is not relabeled as memory nonuse; a generator fabrication may be Risk without making the selected candidate unsuitable in hindsight.

head_and_system_reporting.head: For each of MP/MS/ME/RS, report grouped out-of-fold suitability discrimination, calibration/proper score, selected ON rate, and uncertainty.
head_and_system_reporting.execution: For requested ON cases, report requested-to-planned-to-generator-claimed-to-offline-verified Function and boundary failures.
head_and_system_reporting.system: Compare all 16-action capable learned policy against same-stack always-off, eligible fixed-high, transparent rule, outcome-blind cost-matched fixed, and cost-and-ON-rate-matched random using Quality, Risk, Function, and Cost separately.
head_and_system_reporting.no_arbitrary_new_gate: Use frozen estimands and actual held-out same-stack behavior; do not invent a post-result scalar cutoff merely to declare pass.

review.LLM_role: screening, formatting checks, and sensitivity only unless separately qualified
review.formal_role: source-aware human review for the formal Function subset and human adjudication for material disagreements
review.pairwise_position: balance A/B position and retain raw labels before unblinding
review.provenance: retain rater identity class, codebook version, raw judgment, evidence spans, adjudication, and final projection
